map.四个部门月支出均值分别为 52/48/61/45 万元，极差最大的是均值 61: Four departments have average monthly spending of 52/48/61/45 (ten-thousands); the largest range is the department averaging 61 (low 38, high 96); a large range signals rushed spending, so shift approval to an even monthly rhythm instead of concentrated quarter-end claims.
map.改进前单位成本中位数 21.4 元、改进后 19.8 元，同时标准差由 3.6: The median unit cost fell from 21.4 to 19.8, and the standard deviation from 3.6 to 1.9; both dropping together shows the improvement comes from the process as a whole rather than a single batch.
map.方差按总体还是样本口径算？: Is variance computed for the population or a sample?
map.页面按总体口径（离差平方和除以 n）计算，适合把当前这批数据当作全部考察对象；若: The page uses the population convention (sum of squared deviations divided by n), suitable when the current batch is the entire population; if you are inferring a population from a sample, switch to the unbiased n-1 estimate yourself.
map.数据里有异常值怎么办？: What if the data contains outliers?
map.均值与方差对异常值敏感，先看最大值/最小值是否为录入错误，剔除后再算；中位数与极: The mean and variance are sensitive to outliers, so first check whether the maximum/minimum are entry errors and remove them before computing; the median and range are less affected by a single extreme value and can cross-check the result.
